name: event-analytics
title: Event Analytics (Real-Time Intelligence)
description: Architecture blueprint for streaming-first analytics on Fabric Real-Time Intelligence: ingest live events through an Eventstream into an Eventhouse/KQL Database, analyze with KQL, visualize on a Real-Time Dashboard, and trigger actions with an Activator. Best for telemetry, IoT, logs, and any up-to-the-second monitoring.
best_for: Real-time/streaming workloads: IoT telemetry, application logs, clickstream, monitoring — where freshness matters more than long historical batch.
primary_storage: Eventhouse / KQL Database (KQL, hot analytics store)
key_ingestion: Eventstream (streaming); Copy Job / Pipeline for batch backfill

item_set.purpose: KQL database (tables, policies) inside the Eventhouse
Ingest + route + lightly transform live event sources

decisions.guidance: Eventstream when routing/joining/transforming multiple sources or fan-out; direct ingest for a single simple stream.
Add a Copy Job/Pipeline only if you must seed history into the KQL DB; pure real-time flows skip it.
Activator for rule-based triggers; Operations Agent (preview) for AI-driven monitoring.

build_with.deploy_ordering: Eventhouse + KQLDatabase (Foundation) before Eventstream (Ingestion) before KQLDashboard and Reflex; fabio deploy handles it.
outline: Create an eventhouse and a KQL database (fabio eventhouse create; kql-database create).
Create the KQL table(s) and an eventstream that lands events into them (see workflow rti-pipeline).
Explore with KQL (fabio kql-database query / rti nl2kql for natural-language KQL).
Build a Real-Time Dashboard; add an Activator (reflex) for alerts.
